description: Implementation of a Perplexity language model service that extends OpenAILLMService to interact with Perplexity's API, handle token usage reporting, and provide chat completion parameters.

classes.name: PerplexityLLMService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Perplexity's API, extending OpenAILLMService to handle token usage and request parameters specific to Perplexity.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PerplexityLLMService with API key, base URL, model, and other settings.

methods.name: build_chat_completion_params
methods.description: Builds request parameters for Perplexity chat completion, including optional OpenAI-compatible parameters.

methods.name: _process_context
methods.description: Processes a given LLM context, overrides parent method to handle incremental token reporting and final metrics reporting.

methods.name: start_llm_usage_metrics
methods.description: Accumulates token usage metrics during streaming, reporting total tokens at the end of processing.
